description: Community lets store: static uniques you can open in a browser pane and talk through with Claude.

uniques.name: cocode
uniques.title: Cocode — talk in code
uniques.description: Type in any language, even one that doesn't exist: Claude predicts your next lines as a ghost, builds the real program ahead so Run is instant, performs for real any line that reaches outside the sandbox (ping, browser, search, an agent), and reads what you send as a question or a task. Installed from the store; not a default.
uniques.author: TikoTikTok

uniques.name: den
uniques.title: Den — Doto's home
uniques.description: See what the companion learned about you and edit or forget any of it by pointing: persona, traits, likes, nicknames, memory, skills, secrets found. Installed by default with lets 0.6.0.
uniques.author: TikoTikTok

uniques.name: graph
uniques.title: Graph — talk in diagrams
uniques.description: Draw flows and ideas; the companion and Claude read and edit the same board. Installed by default with lets.
uniques.author: TikoTikTok

uniques.name: mors
uniques.title: Mors — talk in Morse
uniques.description: One key, one tape: key your message in dots and dashes and send it to Claude, who reads it as a prompt. Only Doto helps you craft it (read-back, spell as a ghost, chart, full controller), and Claude can answer in Morse on the tape. Installed from the store; not a default.
uniques.author: TikoTikTok

uniques.name: pulse
uniques.title: Pulse — a dial you talk through
uniques.description: The template unique: a mood dial with three modes; the companion reacts. Start here to build your own.
